policy.purpose: Lightweight community game recommendations and subjective caution notes; not AI-use determinations.
policy.privacy: Do not collect or publish social account IDs or personal identifiers. If evidence screenshots are published, redact ordinary users while retaining context.
policy.evidence: Screenshots establish what was said, not whether a game uses AI.
policy.labeling: Subjective AI-like style impressions must never be presented as verified generative AI use.

submissions.note: Steam game identity verified; recommendation remains user-submitted and is not a human-made or AI-free certification.

submissions.disclaimer: A player's subjective impression of AI-like art is not evidence of actual generative AI use.
